prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the supplied screenshot into a polished Chinese onboarding navigation illustration. Preserve the real UI composition, aspect ratio, app branding, all non-private UI labels and control locations. No interface redesign, no invented controls, no red rectangles. Use restrained blue-violet (#6656C8) numbered badges, thin leader lines, white or pale lavender small rounded callout labels in unused space. Preserve readability. Privacy masks must be flattened strong frosted blur or opaque frosted obscuration: private content must be completely illegible, not merely slightly defocused. Do not replace private details with new names or fake sample documents. Output one edited PNG, no montage. Do not alter configuration text. Keep the same full screenshot framing and as much of the original resolution as possible.
Edit target: AsyncTest home screen with five product cards. Add ONE badge '1' and the exact callout '进入 AsyncTest Mind', placed in the empty area just below the second card. A short fine leader should point to the second card labelled 'AsyncTest Mind / 思维导图', without covering the text or logo. Strongly blur the personal face/avatar in the top-right header; keep the other general app controls unchanged. Leave the large empty background clean. Do not annotate other product cards.

The entire lower region from below the header onward must be frosted into unreadable soft neutral shapes, so no private text or thumbnail structure is recoverable visually. Keep the top AsyncTest logo, '最近打开', general help text and the three header buttons unchanged. No private file text may remain readable.

Do not edit or truncate these strings. Keep all '复制' buttons readable and the existing version labels intact. Use one fine vertical guide with four short thin pointers ending just outside the right edge of the four copy buttons, without covering them. Do not point to '复制提示词': that is a separate update helper. Add a small annotation note below the callout: '以自己电脑显示的配置为准'. Use a callout width that fits the existing right margin; do not shrink or reposition the modal.

source_basis: User-provided screenshots and user-described three-step navigation
personal_information_visual_review: Avatar and recent documents not legible in edited outputs
limits: Generated annotations may redraw pixels; these are navigation illustrations, not original business evidence.
Copy actual settings from the current user application, not from the illustration.
New-chat inline rendering and actual client setup remain unverified.
